main_baseline.direction_rule: Apply source_gain_criteria with M in place of D within this independent cohort.
main_baseline.M: Full material publication, combined physics delivery, legacy presentation and source-default cadence. No integrated continuation.
main_baseline.C: Full material publication, early physics delivery, coherent presentation, repaired cadence and continuation Off.
main_baseline.I: Untimed incompatibility preflight for the current Wave profile; no substituted performance arm.

source_gain_criteria.steps_per_second: Each C arm exceeds each D arm.
source_gain_criteria.p95_and_p99_physical_gaps: Each C arm is lower than each D arm for both quantiles.
source_gain_criteria.maximum_and_severe_counts: Each C maximum inter-step gap and threshold count is at most the worse of the two D arms for that metric.

scope: Primary D/C/C/D source comparison with full publication, continuation Off, early physics and coherent presentation. The final phase adds a separate M/C/C/M whole-source comparison. Candidate-only continuation and renderer diagnostics have separate ordered cohorts. Preserve all attempts and admit only matching software-renderer workloads and exact equal-step physical/input outcomes. I receives an explicit untimed incompatibility preflight. Physical Windows/NVIDIA acceptance is HOLD.
